transactions.currency_mismatch_fix: 2026-08-03: sale_price changed from RMB420,000,000 (agreed property value, per p10/Note 14a) to SGD 75,500,000 (same 'agreed property value' concept, disclosed in SGD at Note 25/28 area, FY2025 full.md line 7820) so it matches the SGD-denominated reference_value/basis_value (51,367,000 SGD, carrying value as at 31 Dec 2023). No SGD carrying value could be found in RMB anywhere in either FY2024 or FY2025 AR (only $51,316,000 and $51,367,000 SGD figures appear), so the RMB side could not be completed instead -- SGD was the only currency in which both a sale-side figure and the carrying-value figure exist. Original RMB420.0 million / S$77.4 million headline figure (p10 Divestments table) remains the more commonly cited number but is a different, less precise figure than the $75.5 million FS-note 'agreed property value' now used as sale_price; do not conflate the two SGD figures.
transactions.notes: DISCLOSED figure, not derived -- do not recompute. Basis is book_value at 31 DECEMBER 2023 specifically (not 2024): reference_value 51,367,000 SGD taken from the FY2024 AR audited Portfolio Statement (p131) 'At Valuation' column for this property (51,367 S$'000), the only disclosed carrying figure at that date. The FY2025 AR pledge-note carrying value at 31 Dec 2024 was a close but distinct S$51,316,000 (p196) -- NOT used here because the disclosed 50% premium is explicitly anchored to the Dec-2023 figure, not Dec-2024. Sale consideration RMB420.0m = S$77.4m headline (Investments/Divestments highlight p10); FS Note discloses agreed property value S$75.5m and net divestment consideration S$64.5m (p216/217, gain on divestment of assets held for sale S$17,027k, Note 28 p217). Do not conflate: p10's Divestments table also shows a slightly different premium context (2.2% exit-yield column, not price premium) -- see p10 table row 1 for cross-reference; premium basis footnote (p10 fn1) corroborates 'book value as at 31 December 2023'.

transactions.currency_mismatch_fix: 2026-08-03: sale_price changed from JPY 25,000,000,000 to SGD 210,300,000 (the FS-disclosed 'consideration', full.md line 7832) so it matches the SGD-denominated reference_value (108,647,000 SGD, Portfolio Statement 'At Valuation' 2024 column, line 5054). Checked the Portfolio Statement (lines 5040-5058) for a JPY column parallel to the SGD one -- unlike AU8U's China portfolio table, this Japan table is SGD-only ($'000), so no JPY valuation figure exists anywhere in the AR to pair with the JPY25.0bn headline price instead. SGD was therefore the only currency in which both a sale-side figure and the valuation figure are disclosed. Original JPY25.0bn / S$222.7m headline (Portfolio Statement footnote 3, p132/5062, and Divestments table p10) remains the more commonly cited figure but is a different, rounder number than the $210.3 million FS 'consideration' now used as sale_price.
transactions.notes: PRIMARY basis is the independent VALUATION as at 31 Dec 2024 (S$108,647k), per FS Note footnote 3 -- this is the basis recorded above (pct_source disclosed, reference_basis valuation). A SEPARATE ~100% figure ('c.100%') also appears in the Divestments Completed in FY2025 highlight table (p10), but on a DIFFERENT basis: p10 footnote 1 states that figure is computed against the property's BOOK VALUE as at 30 June 2025 (not the Dec-2024 independent valuation used in the audited FS note). Both bases happen to round to ~100% but are NOT the same figure -- do not conflate. The alternate book-value-basis figure from p10: gain_loss_pct 100.0 (disclosed as 'c.100%'), reference_basis book_value, reference_value not separately disclosed as a number (only the premium % is given on p10; the 30-Jun-2025 book value itself is not printed). Sale consideration JPY25.0bn = S$222.7m headline (p10); FS Note discloses net divestment consideration S$210.3m (p217) and gain on disposal of investment properties S$82,011k (Note 28, p217, sole investment-property divestment in FY2025).
